title: flag docs whose example CLI output strings disagree with the expected output in cli_test.go

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Docs quote the output of ork's CLI commands. Nothing checks those quotes against the strings that `internal/cli/cli_test.go` expects, so they drift. The ui filed this as tool feedback during S345. `docs/design.md` said `implementer:18 patterns` while `internal/cli/cli_test.go` had moved to 25. Today `docs/design.md:4373` and `internal/cli/cli_test.go:3263` both say 26, so that instance was fixed by hand. The same drift exists now at `docs/design.md:4381-4382`. It quotes `permissions=implementer:3 patterns; reviewer:read-only`, but `internal/cli/cli_test.go:2493` expects `permissions=implementer:2 patterns; reviewer:read-only`.

The owner decided (adj 648, key `review.doc-cli-output-lint`, 2026-11-27) to build this as a Go test run by `go test ./...`. It compares the CLI output strings quoted in `docs/design.md` with the expected strings in `internal/cli/cli_test.go` and fails on a mismatch. S518 and S536 were split off as separate follow-ups. The repo already has a test-only package for doc lints, `internal/docscheck`, which checks code citations in `docs/guide.md` and `docs/design.md`. The new lint goes there.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 648 (a go test lint, docs/design.md vs cli_test.go) and adj 654 (digit-masked substring pairing, 3+ word spans with a digit).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All tests are in `internal/docscheck/cliout_test.go` (new), package `docscheck`. Until the helpers exist the package does not compile, so every test fails.
- TestQuotedSpansJoinWrappedLines: for a doc text where one backtick span wraps across a line break and indentation (``` `permissions=implementer:3 patterns;\n  reviewer:read-only` ```), `quotedSpans` returns the span with each whitespace run collapsed to one space. It skips fenced code blocks, and an unmatched backtick in one paragraph does not swallow the next paragraph.
- TestTestStringLiteralsUnquotesGoStrings: for Go source holding an interpreted literal with `\n` and `\"`, a raw backtick literal, and a `"a" + x + "b"` concatenation, `testStringLiterals` returns each literal as its unquoted value, one entry per literal. Each entry has its whitespace collapsed.
- TestCLIOutputQuoteDisagreementIsFlagged: the doc span `implementer:18 patterns (preset python)` against the literal `updated slicer: permissions=implementer:25 patterns (preset python)\n` returns one error. The error names the doc span and the test string.
- TestCLIOutputQuoteAgreementPasses: nothing is flagged in these three cases.
  - The doc span equals a fragment of a test literal (`implementer:26 patterns (preset python)`).
  - The doc span has no counterpart in any literal once digits are masked.
  - The doc span is shorter than three words (`exit 2`).
- TestDesignCLIOutputQuotesMatchCLITests: reads `docs/design.md` and `internal/cli/cli_test.go` from the repo root, as `TestGuideAndDesignCitationsResolve` does, and fails on any mismatch. Before `docs/design.md:4393-4394` is fixed it fails on `permissions=implementer:3 patterns; reviewer:read-only` against `internal/cli/cli_test.go:2493`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
This draft assumes option 1 of the owner question below, the digit-masked pairing rule. Steps 3 and 4 follow that choice.
1. Create `internal/docscheck/cliout_test.go` with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later` and `package docscheck`. Use only the standard library (`go/parser`, `go/ast`, `go/token`, `strconv`, `regexp`, `strings`).
2. Add `quotedSpans(text string) []string`. Reuse `fencedBlock` and `backtickSpan` from `internal/docscheck/cite_test.go`. Remove fenced blocks, split the text on a blank line as `parseCitations` does, and collect each backtick span. Collapse each whitespace run in a span to one space and trim it.
3. Add `testStringLiterals(src string) ([]string, error)`. Parse the source with `go/parser.ParseFile`, walk it with `ast.Inspect`, and for each `*ast.BasicLit` of kind `token.STRING` take `strconv.Unquote(lit.Value)` with whitespace collapsed. Each literal is its own entry, so a concatenation such as `"..." + check + "..."` yields its pieces.
4. Add `checkCLIOutputQuotes(spans, literals []string) []error`. Mask every digit run to `#` in a span and in each literal. Only a span with at least three words and at least one digit takes part. A span is paired with a literal when the masked span is a substring of the masked literal. If any paired literal contains the span exactly (unmasked), the span agrees. Otherwise return an error that names the doc span and the first paired literal. A span with no pair is ignored.
5. Add `TestDesignCLIOutputQuotesMatchCLITests`. Read `docs/design.md` and `internal/cli/cli_test.go` through `filepath.Join("..", "..", ...)`. Fail if `testStringLiterals` returns no literals or `quotedSpans` returns no spans. Report each error from `checkCLIOutputQuotes` with `t.Error`.
6. Add the four unit tests named under Failing tests, with small inline inputs.
7. Run `TestDesignCLIOutputQuotesMatchCLITests`. Edit `docs/design.md` so each reported span matches the string `internal/cli/cli_test.go` expects. The first one is at `docs/design.md:4381-4382`: change `implementer:3 patterns` to `implementer:2 patterns` to match `internal/cli/cli_test.go:2493`. Change `internal/cli/cli_test.go` in no case. If the real run reports a span whose example the doc means as an illustration, not a quote of test output, stop and ask the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: go test ./... passes. After the change a doc quote that disagrees with the test's expected output makes go test ./internal/docscheck fail, and the failure names both strings.
- `go test -run TestQuotedSpansJoinWrappedLines ./internal/docscheck` passes.
- `go test -run TestTestStringLiteralsUnquotesGoStrings ./internal/docscheck` passes.
- `go test -run TestCLIOutputQuoteDisagreementIsFlagged ./internal/docscheck` passes.
- `go test -run TestCLIOutputQuoteAgreementPasses ./internal/docscheck` passes.
- `go test -run TestDesignCLIOutputQuotesMatchCLITests ./internal/docscheck` passes. It fails if docs/design.md:4381-4382 is put back to implementer:3 patterns.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
